name: FastVideo FastH3 — text to video with sound (8 steps)
description:
Write a scene and get a short film back WITH its soundtrack — dialogue, effects and music are generated together with the picture, in sync.

This is MiniMax H3 distilled to 8 sampling steps by FastVideo, so it is several times quicker than the full model for a small loss of detail.

Describe it like a shot list: camera angle and movement, what is in frame, what happens, and then the sound. The model was trained on descriptions that name the audio explicitly — "we hear footsteps on gravel and distant traffic" earns you that soundtrack; saying nothing about sound gets you whatever it invents.

Duration is in seconds at 24 fps and is snapped to the model’s own frame grid. Keep clips short: cost grows with length and with resolution.

Text to video only. This distilled checkpoint was never trained for first/last-frame conditioning — for that use "MiniMax H3 — first / last frame", which runs the undistilled model.

promptGuides.label: MiniMax H3 — official video prompt guide
promptGuides.tip: Write shot by shot: framing and camera move, subject and action, setting and light — then say what is heard. Naming the audio is what gets you a deliberate soundtrack.

promptGuides.label: FastVideo FastH3 8-Step V2 — the distilled checkpoint
